raw.query: SELECT MAX(ABS(v.mean_ms - a.mean_ms) / a.mean_ms) AS max_error FROM (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'vllm' AND image_px = 448 AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json') v JOIN (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'aic' AND image_px = 448 AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/aic_multires.json') a USING (n_images) WHERE v.n_images <= 64;
raw.evidence: Joining eager vLLM standalone vision tower measurements on RTX 5090 (vllm_eager_dense.json) with AIC predictions (aic_multires.json) at 448px shows a maximum absolute error of 11.43% across the N<=64 serving regime (and up to 12.7% max residual).
